start.title: The Map in the Attic
start.text: On a rainy afternoon, you are exploring an old box of family things when you discover a folded map. Across the top are the words: THE HIDDEN TRAIL. A dotted line begins near your home and ends at a large X beside a symbol you do not recognize.

choices.label: Ask a family member about the map

study_map.title: Reading the Clues
study_map.text: You notice three clues drawn along the route: a tall tree, three stones, and a bridge. In the corner someone wrote, 'Good explorers notice what others miss.'

choices.label: Start looking for the first landmark

pack_gear.title: Ready to Explore
pack_gear.text: You gather a small notebook, pencil, water bottle, and the map. With permission to explore the safe route, you step outside and begin your expedition.

ask_family.title: An Old Family Story
ask_family.text: A family member smiles when they see the map. They remember hearing about a little exploration trail made years ago, but no one remembers where it ends. They tell you to watch for an old tree with a split trunk.

alternate_route.title: The Long Way Around
alternate_route.text: The longer route takes you past places you usually ignore. Near a fence you spot three flat stones stacked in a row. They look exactly like the second symbol on the map.

first_landmark.title: The Split Tree
first_landmark.text: You find a tall tree with a trunk that divides into two large branches. At its base is a small wooden marker shaped like an arrow. The arrow points away from the usual path.

choices.label: Search around the tree for another clue

search_tree.title: A Mark in the Bark
search_tree.text: You do not remove or damage anything. Looking closely, you spot a tiny compass symbol on the old wooden marker. The north point has been darkened with pencil.

choices.label: Use the clue to search north

follow_arrow.title: The Narrow Path
follow_arrow.text: The arrow leads to a narrow but safe path. After a short walk, you reach three large stones beside the trail. One has a shallow star shape painted on it.

choices.label: Listen for the bridge or water

stone_clue.title: Three Stones
stone_clue.text: Behind the middle stone you find another wooden marker. It reads, 'Where footsteps cross but water keeps moving, look beneath the shadow.' You realize the next clue must be near a bridge.

choices.label: Find higher ground and look around

listen_water.title: Following the Sound
listen_water.text: You stop talking and listen. In the distance you hear water moving. Following the sound brings you to a small footbridge on the marked route.

high_ground.title: Explorer's View
high_ground.text: From a small rise you can see the split tree behind you and a footbridge ahead. You also notice a patch of bright wildflowers beside the bridge that is not shown on the map.

flowers.title: A Useful Detour
flowers.text: You admire the flowers without picking them. Beside the patch is a weathered post with the same strange symbol drawn beside the X on your map. Now you know you are close.

bridge.title: Beneath the Shadow
bridge.text: You stand on the bridge and remember the clue: look beneath the shadow. The bridge casts a long shadow beside the trail. At its edge, partly covered by leaves, is a flat wooden box.

inspect_box.title: The Explorer Mark
inspect_box.text: The box is old but sturdy. On the lid is the symbol from the map: a compass inside a star. Beneath it are the words, 'For the explorer who made it this far.'

open_box.title: The Hidden Trail
open_box.text: Inside is no gold or treasure. Instead you find a small notebook filled with names, dates, sketches, and discoveries made by explorers who followed the trail before you. The final blank page is waiting.

choices.label: Write a clue for the next explorer

write_entry.title: A New Explorer
write_entry.text: You write your name, the date, and your favorite discovery from the journey. You return the notebook to the box exactly as you found it. The hidden trail was never about treasure. It was about paying attention, exploring carefully, and becoming part of a story that continues with every new explorer.

leave_note.title: For the Next Explorer
leave_note.text: You write a short note: 'Look closely. The best discoveries are easy to walk past.' You return the notebook and close the box. On the way home, familiar places seem different because now you know how much can be discovered when you really look.
